headline: Drones Save Lives as Mozambique Weathers Worst Flood in Decades
meta_description: Nine drone systems and 30 trained specialists helped Marracuene district survive its worst flood in decades without any deaths.
summary_short: A new drone rescue system enabled Mozambique's Marracuene district to survive its worst flood in decades with zero fatalities.
body:
Mozambique's Marracuene district has emerged from its worst flood in decades without losing a single life—a milestone made possible by a new drone rescue system deployed across the region.

Nine drone systems, operated by 30 government specialists who had received training in the technology, proved instrumental in locating those in danger during the disaster. The drones provided a rapid, bird's-eye view of flooded areas, allowing rescue teams to reach people quickly and efficiently when conventional methods would have been far slower.

The success of this coordinated response demonstrates how targeted technology and human expertise can transform disaster outcomes. What could have been a tragedy instead became a story of preparedness and innovation—proof that when communities invest in modern tools and skilled personnel, lives are saved.
quick_facts: Marracuene district, Mozambique survived worst flood in decades
Nine drone systems deployed across the disaster zone
30 trained government specialists operated the rescue technology
Zero deaths recorded despite severe flooding
